summary: The mechanism is real for the consumer-bound classes (high, ft): the w2 epilogue has a gs load after the last wgmma_wait plus a scatter loop doing an L1-missing sorted_ids __ldg each pass, while the tensor core is idle. Low is at the HBM byte floor and should be flat. Headline ~0.15-0.6%, far below readability: the only readable evidence is the in-prepare interleaved warm+cold gate. This is the w2 subset of the queued experts-rega-epilogue-wg-local-bulk-store and does not stack with it; comparing scored rows to ec3bd018 is not readable.
justification: gsc = __ldg(gs + m.e) sits after wgmma_wait<0>/fence_acc; the scatter loop loads sorted_ids per 16-B chunk, each a new L1 line. Both consumer warpgroups run in lockstep, so exposed epilogue cycles are lost tensor time (fast silu's w13 x0.91-0.94 supports exposure). ft: w2 item ~30K clk; gs + 2-8 scatter round trips is 5-15% of it; x0.94-0.985 plausible. high: 6-8 scatter passes, plausible. low: w2 weights 604 MB in 136.4 us = 4.43 TB/s (92% of spec), HBM-bound, 1-3 passes, hidden by the 4-stage ring: expect flat. Headline ~0.15-0.6%. Weakest link: whether ptxas already unrolls/batches the scatter loads, and TMA contention of 128 one-row bulk stores with the producer's loads at ft. Prior (fast-silu) fair. Sibling experts-rega-epilogue-wg-local-bulk-store contains this change's w2 content: re-baseline, do not add. Same-code jobs 21911eb6 vs ec3bd018 differ by 1.4-14% on w2 rows, so judge on the same-process interleaved gate (warm-L2 and judge-like pop first; cold-only is not evidence).
confounders: experts-rega-w13-fast-silu-epilogue: the new w2 compiles into and dispatches from the fsilu module; compare fsilu's PATH CHOSEN lines with ec3bd018 before attributing; w2st is unavailable when fsilu ext is None.
experts-turn-rega-s4-*: the 4-stage ring hides part of the epilogue (low flat by construction) and the producer shares the TMA unit with the bulk stores; a reading caveat.
align-two-phase-all-t-rega + combo-a normgather set nbk/nvalid (scatter passes) and keep sorted_ids L2-hot.
stack-tonight-five-prefill (zero_nonlocal_w2): keep the sid < 0 / >= num_routes skip predicate exactly.
interference: No companion run. Fold the control into the gate: compile w2 with a template bool STORE_BULK in the same build; false = only the early gs/sid load (write sid into a 128-int __shared__ table before the staging named_bar and have master's 16-B st.global scatter loop read s_sid[t]). Time it alongside master and the full change in the same 2 x 11 alternations, cold and warm, both routings.

Do 128 separate 256-B cp.async.bulk stores per item delay the producer at ft? The STORE_BULK=false arm answers it.
